text:
sara: Quick sync — co-sell onramp for the marketplace appliance coming next quarter. We need a commit->consumption funding playbook + comms plan. Tagging @jordan @vikram for pricing and SI uplift ideas. Thoughts?

jordan: Love it. My instinct: 3-tier onramp (POC, Ramp, Full) with blended credits + short reserved commitments. Keep it simple for sales to explain. :thumbsup:

vikram: Agree. Draft proposal: 
```
POC: $10k credit (30d)
Ramp: $50k program -> $25k commitment + $25k usage credit
Full: $250k commit -> 10% discount + reserved capacity options
```
Also include an option to convert unused credits into committed consumption at a defined rate.

liz: From ops/legal side we need explicit SKU mapping + a clause for credit expiry and renewal conversion. cc @matt for renewal mechanics.

matt: Renewal play: credits expire after 12 months; if customer converts, unused credits count toward next period at 60% conversion rate. Recommend 12-mo auto-renew with opt-out window at 30 days.

sara: Communications cadence suggestion: 1) Pre-announce to SI partners + enablement kit, 2) Marketplace private offer live, 3) Customer case study + joint press 60–90 days after launch. Keep messaging tight for the marketplace listing.

partner-relations-bot: New private offer template uploaded: /drive/marketplace/private-offer-v2.docx (sha: f3a2c1)

jordan: Can we do hardware partner subsidies as a separate tranche? e.g., hardware partner covers first $50k or provides a % uplift to commit conversion to accelerate buys. That helps appliance partners justify the bundle.

vikram: Good call. Also need an operational rule: if customer hits >80% of committed spend before month 6, auto-trigger a review to bump them into reserved capacity with a pre-negotiated discount (fast-path escalation).

liz: I'll draft the contract language for credit expiry, conversion rate, and escalation clause. Need SKU mapping from infra/product. @devon can you share SKU matrix?

devon: sending SKU matrix now. sample snippet: ```sku_map = {'APPL-BASE': 'redwood-appliance-100', 'APPL-PLUS': 'redwood-appliance-500', 'APPL-EDGE': 'redwood-appliance-edge'}``` Will attach spreadsheet in the thread.

sara: Perfect. Next steps checklist:
- liz: draft clauses by Tue (legal + ops)
- devon: full SKU matrix EOD
- jordan: build pricing table + 2 example customer scenarios (POC -> Full)
- vikram: define escalation thresholds and ops flow
- I'll coordinate SI enablement and announcement template after we have clauses + pricing

If no objections I'll spin up a follow-up thread for the announcement timeline and assign owners. :white_check_mark:
